scientific_integrity: Fixed-simplex orbit enumeration and the reduced Lefschetz trace calculation provide an all-parameter proof given the cited homotopy theorem. A standalone standard-library checker exhaustively verifies examples; unindexed or unpublished equivalent work cannot be excluded.
scientific_limitations: Only the rational cyclic action for even ladder parameter at least four; relies on Theorem 21 of Agarwal and Basak for homology concentration; no integral representation or equivariant homotopy classification. Finite exact checks are corroboration, not proof of the infinite case.
title: Rotation has order two or four on Möbius-ladder perfect-matching homology
